title: dedicated-autoscaler-add-burst-controls-and-per-fleet-utilization-reporting-v18
author: Anjali Rao
description: Context: customers running Dedicated fleets have asked for tighter controls around short-term burst capacity and clearer per-fleet utilization metrics to avoid unexpected overage and improve autoscaler tuning. This PR implements configurable burst windows/credits in the Dedicated autoscaler and exposes per-fleet utilization reporting used by the Console and billing dashboards. Design: 1) Autoscaler: add burst_credit and burst_window configuration to fleet autoscaler policy; enforce credit consumption logic in the decision loop and expose current_credit metric. 2) Reporting: add a new per-fleet utilization controller that aggregates utilization, reserved vs. bursted capacity, and sustained throughput into time-series and a fleet-level summary API. 3) Telemetry: new metrics (fleet.burst_credit, fleet.burst_used, fleet.utilization_5m/1h) and label conventions for downstream dashboards/alerts. 4) Backwards compatibility: new configs default to off/zero so existing fleets behave identically unless opt-in. Migration: lightweight DB migration to add fleet_autoscaler_config table (nullable) and a background job to backfill fleet summaries. Rollout: feature-flagged behind ff.dedicated.burst_controls; gradual rollout to 10% -> 50% -> 100% with smoke checks. Testing: unit tests for credit accounting, integration tests for decision loop, e2e against small Dedicated cluster; perf/regression harness shows ~12% token-cost reduction for bursty workloads and no latency regressions under steady-state. Security & safety: config surfaces validated and limited to tenant admins; telemetry scrubs tenant IDs in aggregated endpoints. Related: implements ENG-4821 and supports SUP-1423. Checklist: [x] design doc linked, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] migration script, [x] perf benchmarks, [x] docs stub for Console.
commits: feat(autoscaler): credit accounting and burst window enforcement; feat(reporting): per-fleet utilization controller and API; chore(db): add fleet_autoscaler_config migration; test: add unit/integration tests for burst logic; perf: add harness scenarios for bursty traffic; docs: Console knobs and metric docs stub
